lines.say: Mocks are coming, and every subject wants tonight.
So you make a timetable. Colour coded. Perfect.
Then one evening goes wrong, and the whole thing falls apart.
Now you're rewriting the plan instead of revising.
The plan was never the problem. A plan that can't bend is.
Offload reschedules your revision when a day goes wrong.
Comment mocks and I'll send you the plan.
